race.comment: RAVEN'S SILVER (3) was well fancied when resuming last start and proved too strong, scoring by 2.25 lengths over 1000m at this track. Has a strong record at the trip and is the testing material. POSTWAR (4) produced a reasonable effort when fourth last start over 1000m at Wagga, beaten 2.5 lengths. That followed a brilliant win at Albury the start prior and he deserves to be given another chance to see if he can reproduce that. LAURA'S GOLD (12) has spent a bit of time in 62 grade this prep, so she'll find this company suitable and draws beautifully. DIAMOND INDARUF (7) resumes here and goes well fresh with a win and a second from three first-up runs. Ran some nice races last prep and has trialled well since the last run, which suggests he might be able to turn things around.
